10k.note: Clinical-stage regenerative medicine company. Lead asset Cellspan Esophageal Implant (CEI) in P1 first-in-human study; remaining bronchial, tracheal, colon, and uterine patch programs are pre-clinical (excluded).

website.note: Pipeline page lists Cellspan Esophageal, Bronchial, and Tracheal Implants as platform programs plus pre-clinical Colon Biodevice (with U Pitt) and Reproductive Patch (with Yale).

pipeline.modality: Autologous-cell-seeded biocompatible tubular scaffold (regenerative organ implant / combination device)

indications.indication: Short-segment esophageal replacement (esophageal diseases including cancer-related resection, traumatic injury, caustic burns, chemoradiation damage)
indications.trial_name: Safety and Feasibility Study of the CELLSPAN Esophageal Implant (CEI) in Patients Requiring Short Segment Esophageal Replacement
indications.trial_design: First-in-human, open-label safety and feasibility study; two surgical implantation cohorts (thoracic full-reconstruction and extra-thoracic subdermal in patients with prior partial esophagectomy)
key_milestones: Strategic collaboration announced October 2024 with Children's Hospital, Capital Institute of Pediatrics (Beijing) for esophageal atresia indication

excluded_preclinical: Reproductive Patch / uterine endometrial patch for Asherman's syndrome (pre-clinical, Yale collaboration)
